decisive_items: Endobronchial ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration biopsy of mediastinal lymph nodes: ALK-positive lung adenocarcinoma with mucinous features
Positron emission tomography-computed tomography of full body: small foci suspicious for metastatic disease
response.rationale: Pathology confirms ALK-positive lung adenocarcinoma, which is the primary diagnosis. Paraneoplastic syndrome (R1) is a secondary manifestation of the cancer, not the underlying disease. Metastatic disease (R4) is a consequence, not the diagnosis. Rheumatoid arthritis (R3) is excluded by negative RF and lack of erosions.

rejected.why: Metastatic disease is a complication of the lung adenocarcinoma, not the primary diagnosis.
Negative rheumatoid factor and unremarkable radiographs for erosions argue against rheumatoid arthritis.
Paraneoplastic syndrome is a manifestation of the underlying lung adenocarcinoma, not the most likely primary diagnosis.
